notes: The String Wall (NP_08 s2.3): the connection maps as data - a corkboard in the Old Gym office, red string between the people a club can reach through who it already has. Three kinds of node: a FIGHTER is a recruits.v1.json record (C29's ledger holds his state); a LEAD is a person the docs name who has no card in the sim (the staff recruits the questlines name, Vera Iron, the unnamed students, cousins and pairs the rewards promise - never a new name); a HOUSE is its crest and its blessing line (NP_07A's, quoted). Three kinds of link, and what each reveals: FAMILY (either way: a relative recruited reveals the relative), MASTER (one way: a master recruited reveals his students), HOUSE (a member recruited reveals his house; the house's blessing - the overworld's story flag blessing:<house> - reveals its members and the houses bound to it on the feud graph, ALLIED / MARRIAGE / DEBT, never across a FEUD; a house with no one left to bless opens with its crest). A revealed fighter's condition surfaces as an approach would (C29's approached, with the string he came by); a revealed lead is a lead: on the wall, with its condition when the docs author one, joining nothing the sim builds. The BOND conditions the roster docs authored are the first strings (Dex -> Moira, Carter -> Ada, Sam -> the Choir). Six maps and 43 nodes composed from the questlines' own people: the grouping, the labels of the unnamed and every lead's role are first drafts.

family.reveals: both ways: a relative recruited reveals the relative

master.reveals: one way, a -> b: a master recruited reveals his students

house.reveals: a -> b on the member's join: his house; b -> a on the house's blessing: its members (and the houses bound to it on the feud graph, never across a FEUD); a house with no blessing opens with its crest
house.text: houses chain through blessings (NP_08 s2.3; NP_08 s3)

node_kinds.fighter: a recruits.v1.json record - his state is C29's recruit ledger

node_kinds.house: a house's crest and its blessing line (NP_07A); blessed when the overworld's blessing:<house> flag is set
